"The first warranty is five years sixty thousand mile Base limited warranty" "The second is ten years hundred thousand mile powertrain which is referring to the engine and the transmission, im sure you and i agree thats a very good complementary warranty from the manufacturer

facts.topic: What happens when the car breaks down
facts.answer: If the breakdown is a design, build or install fault, the manufacturer pays; if it is wear and tear or the owner's cause, the owner pays. The manufacturer decides which. The service place must first diagnose the vehicle, by law.
source_quotes: And the first thing you do as in owner when the vehicle break down you go to any service place and the first thing the first place will do before they say anything to you by the law they must first diagnose the vehicle to find out what is the problem, once they diagnose the vehicle the manufacturer will step in and they are very cautious.

WHY ? because the manufacturer reserve the right to determine if the break down happen due to any Mis design or mis built or miss installed if they find out the break down happen because of them thats great because they will pay for it igf they find out the break down happen cause of you or the wear and tear unfortunately you will pay for it and like i said before 95% of the time when the vehicle break down it due to the wear and tear.

facts.answer: Engine can cost up to $7,000, transmission $6,000, AC almost $4,000. Electronics and technology can cost anywhere from $100 to $12,000.
source_quotes: Thats why we don't feel comfortable that we will leave you in a good position without a good warranty around the vehicle. Why because we do have a part department we know how much the parts cost engine by itself can cost up to seven thousand transmission six thousand AC almost four thousand electronic and technology is the luck of the draw could cost anywhere from hundred dollar all the way up to twelve thousand dollar

facts.answer: A failed sensor can mean replacing the whole component, roughly $6,500 to $8,500 depending on the vehicle, not including labor.
source_quotes: if God forbid a sensor break down in the screens in the dashboard they cant just change that sensor that sensor is a part of a huge component they will have to take the whole thing out and replace it with a brand new one thats roughly sixty five hundred dollar part up to eighty five hundred dollar part depends on the vehicle thats not even include the labor charge

facts.answer: Labor is $130 to $160 per hour depending on the technician. Such a job can take 10 to 15 hours.
source_quotes: labor will charge you anywhere between hundred thirty dollar per hour up to hundred sixty dollar per hour depend on the quality of the technician they are using in the service place and a job like that could take anywhere between 10 hours and 15 hours of labor to fix it so instead you pay seventy hundred dollar for parts plus 10 hours of labor. NO ABSOLUTELY NOT

facts.answer: 5-year tire and wheel cover, assuming 2 sets of tires over 5 years depending on driving habits. Eight tires at about $350 each plus $125 installation is almost $500 a tire, almost $4,000 in total, which the policy takes care of.
source_quotes: Also we know that the cost of ownership for you over the next 5 years will cost you thousands of dollars to maintain the vehicle thats why we include for you 5 years tire and wheel cover im assuming you will need 2 sets of tires over the next 5 years depends on your driving habits so instead you pay for 8 tiers three hundred and fifty dollar for each tire plus hundred and twenty five dollar installation thats almost five hundred dollar a pice 8 of those will cost almost 4 thousand dollar instead you pay that no the policy will take care of that for you so you don't have to worry about paying that much

facts.answer: Covers full synthetic oil changes, filters and tire rotations. Without it: $125 per oil change, $29 filter, $140 tire rotation each visit. {{TERM_CONFLICT_MAINT}}
source_quotes: We also include for you the 5 years maintenance package that cover all your full synthetic oil change filters and tire rotation so instead you pay for a hundred twenty five dollar for every oil change plus 29 dollar for filter plus a hundred fourty dollar for tire rotation every time you go to service your vehicle no say good buy to all that

facts.answer: Under the policy the only thing the customer has to pay is gas. Gas is not covered.
source_quotes: Under this policy the only thing you have to worry about is just paying for your GAS and guess what we don't have cover for that

facts.answer: Everything is available for a set price per day, compared to a Starbucks coffee at $8.60 a day. Prices come from the controller only: $4, then $3.50, then $3.25, floor $3 per day.
source_quotes: You can get everything i just mentioned for only {{per_day_price}} a day a coffee a day and everything is covered in your vehicle not even that a coffee a day from starbucks is 8 dollars and sixty cent for less then half a cup of a coffee a day you will get everything covered so you don't have to worry about paying anyone anything in the future

source_quotes: Which two of those do you see the most value in? We want to make sure you get the exact coverage that makes the most sense for your driving habits.

needs_txm.question: Can I cancel and get a refund?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Real refund and proration terms, any fee, who to contact.

needs_txm.question: Can I transfer it if I sell the car?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Yes or no, any fee, how.

needs_txm.question: What if I pay off or trade in the car early?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: What happens to the coverage and to any refund.

needs_txm.question: What exactly is NOT covered?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: The list of exclusions (wear items, cosmetic, accident damage, neglect, etc.).

needs_txm.question: Does it cover the battery / brakes pads / wipers?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Which wear items are included or excluded.

needs_txm.question: Does it cover accidents, hail, flood, theft?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Confirm that this is insurance territory and what the dealership says.

needs_txm.question: Do I need to service at your dealership?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Beat 16 says 'we kindly ask you to come here'. Is it required or only requested? Can they use another shop?

needs_txm.question: Can I use my own mechanic or do my own oil changes?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Whether work done elsewhere keeps coverage valid.

needs_txm.question: What are the mileage limits / does it expire?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Exact mileage and time limits for each product.

needs_txm.question: Is it per day or per month? What is the total?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Total price and how it is billed (added to the loan? monthly?).

needs_txm.question: Is the price negotiable? Can I get it lower?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Confirm the $4 / $3.50 / $3.25 / $3 ladder is the whole policy.

needs_txm.question: Can I buy only some of the products?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Which products can be dropped, and how the price changes.

needs_txm.question: Will it raise my monthly car payment? By how much?

needs_txm.question: Does it affect my loan or my interest rate?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Policy answer, or handoff.

needs_txm.question: Is this required to get the car or the financing?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Must be an honest, approved answer.

needs_txm.question: Is this mandatory? Can I decline it?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Whether the protection package is mandatory or optional, and the approved wording for telling the customer they can decline it and still buy the car. Asked in simulated calls (follow-up 9); today it gets the unknown-question line.

needs_txm.question: Why should I buy yours instead of an outside or third-party warranty?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: An approved comparison with an outside / third-party extended warranty (what this package does that one does not), with no claims about other companies that TXM has not approved. Asked in simulated calls (follow-up 9); today it gets the unknown-question line.

needs_txm.question: Who is the warranty company? Is it the manufacturer?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Name of the provider or administrator.

needs_txm.question: What does zero deductible mean?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: One-sentence approved answer.

needs_txm.question: How do I make a claim? Who do I call?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Claim process and phone number.

needs_txm.question: Does it cover rental car or towing?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Yes or no.

needs_txm.question: Is it valid at any shop or only yours?

needs_txm.question: Does it cover used or aftermarket parts, or modifications?

needs_txm.question: Does it cover commercial or rideshare use (Uber, delivery)?

needs_txm.question: Can I talk to a person / the manager?
needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Real handoff procedure and what Max says.

needs_txm.txm_must_provide: Policy answer.

hard_rules: AI answers only from facts with status script or approved. If nothing matches, say the approved handoff line and log the question.
AI never states a price, discount, refund, transfer, exclusion, legal or insurance fact from general knowledge.
Prices come only from the pricing controller.
Recording objection, request for a human, anger or legal threat: stop and hand off. No generated answer.
After any answer, return to the current beat and repeat its check-in.
Do not use any fact that contains an unresolved TERM_CONFLICT placeholder.
